result:
Solution 1 is the only candidate that survives a check. I verified its extremal function numerically: for $f(z)=\frac{z-w}{1-\rho z}$ with $\rho^2=\varphi/2$ and $w=\frac{1}{\varphi\rho}$, I get $\|f-f(0)\|_4^4\approx 5.528$ and $\|f\|_4^4\approx 3.414$, so the ratio is about $1.619\approx\varphi$. This gives $\|S^*\|\ge\varphi^{1/4}\approx1.128$. The Riesz projection bound $\|S^*\|\le\csc(\pi/4)=\sqrt2$ also holds. I did not verify that this family is globally extremal, so the confidence is moderate.

Solution 2 is wrong: the formula $2^{|1-2/p|}$ at $p=3$ gives $2^{1/3}\approx1.26$, which exceeds the Riesz projection bound $\csc(\pi/3)\approx1.155$, so the formula cannot be right in general.

Solution 3 is wrong: the $H^{4/3}$ shift is an isometry, but the $H^4$ norm is not the dual norm of $H^{4/3}$ under the standard pairing, so $\|S^*\|=\|S\|$ does not follow. The explicit test function above already gives a norm ratio above 1.

CHOICE: 1
CONFIDENCE: 3
